properties.alt-text: Pictured is the Ed Z'berg Sugar Pine Point State Park's dukMéʔem wáťa, "Wave Creek" with a scenic view of trees alongside the creek.
properties.title: dukMéʔem wáťa

properties.site_description: Renamed in 2024, Ed Z'berg Sugar Pine Point State Park's dukMéʔem wáťa is the park's Creek that extends 9.3 miles across the State Park. Formerly known as "General Creek," dukMéʔem wáťa means "Wave Creek" in the Washoe language.
